8:["$","h3",null,{"children":"1. Age (Up to 30 points)"}]
9:["$","p",null,{"children":"Your age matters. Being 25–32 gives you the maximum 30 points. Younger applicants (18–24) get 25, and older applicants get fewer. If you are 45 or older, you cannot apply."}]
a:["$","h3",null,{"children":"2. English (Up to 20 points)"}]
b:["$","p",null,{"children":"Better English means more points. Basic English gives 0 points, moderate gives 10, and strong gives 20. This is usually the easiest category to improve."}]
c:["$","h3",null,{"children":"3. Overseas Work Experience (Up to 15 points)"}]
d:["$","p",null,{"children":"Work done outside Australia in your field counts. More experience means more points, up to 15."}]
e:["$","h3",null,{"children":"4. Australian Work Experience (Up to 20 points)"}]
f:["$","p",null,{"children":"Work done inside Australia in your field also counts. You can earn up to 20 points here, but see the cap below."}]
10:["$","div",null,{"className":"bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg p-4 my-6","children":["$","p",null,{"className":"text-sm text-blue-800","children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Important cap:"}]," Categories 3 and 4 are combined. 11:["$","h3",null,{"children":"5. Education (Up to 20 points)"}]
12:["$","p",null,{"children":"Higher qualifications mean more points. A PhD gives 20, a university degree gives 15, and a diploma or trade gives 10."}]

15:["$","h3",null,{"children":"7. Australian Study (5 points)"}]

17:["$","h3",null,{"children":"8. Regional Study (5 points)"}]
18:["$","p",null,{"children":"If you completed that 2 years of study while living in a regional area, you get an additional 5 points."}]
19:["$","h3",null,{"children":"9. Professional Year (5 points)"}]
1a:["$","p",null,{"children":"A structured work training program for accounting, IT, or engineering graduates. Completing it adds 5 points."}]
1b:["$","h3",null,{"children":"10. Community Language (5 points)"}]
1c:["$","p",null,{"children":"If you are certified as a community language interpreter or translator (through NAATI), you get 5 points."}]
1d:["$","h3",null,{"children":"11. Partner Skills (Up to 10 points)"}]
1e:["$","p",null,{"children":"Your partner's English skills and qualifications can add points. Being single also counts for 10 points."}]
1f:["$","h3",null,{"children":"12. Nomination (5 or 15 points)"}]
20:["$","p",null,{"children":"State nomination for a 190 visa adds 5 points. State or family nomination for a 491 visa adds 15 points."}]
